events.feedback:
Yes. I’ll keep the feedback entirely copy/paste-able, with no text boxes, and I’ll leave the iNaturalist botanical name completely alone. I’m treating the supplied name as the park’s authoritative identification.

Overall, this is a **strong entry**, and I think it has the makings of a particularly good “plant highlight” because the discovery story, coconut resemblance, cold tolerance, and tiny wild population are all genuinely interesting. The main work I’d do is **tighten a few claims, remove a little repetition, and make some wording more defensible**.

## Biggest issues to fix

### 1. Quick Hit #1 is excellent, but the wording can be more precise

Current:

“discovered not in the field, but in the background of a photograph taken for an entirely unrelated survey.”

That is a great story, but “background of a photograph” can make it sound almost accidental in a way that may not be quite right. I’d use:

“Scientists first noticed this palm in 2002 — not during a botanical expedition,
